documentScore: maximum chunk score; stable documentId tie break
hitAt3: documentId deduplicated top3 intersects expected IDs; positive questions only
thresholdCandidates: observed compare20 scores/gaps plus next representable greater values and reject-all boundary; no heldout values
objective: zero false evidence on compare20 negatives
minimize false no-evidence on compare20 positives
on ties choose larger tau_abs then larger tau_gap (lex larger tau_lex)
heldout: apply frozen thresholds once; never retune; create exclusive evaluation marker before reading heldout scores

randomBaseline.assumptions: 10 docs, exactly one relevant doc, uniformly sampled 3 distinct docs

chunking.boundary: prefer paragraphs, preserve title on each chunk

futureRetrievedPolicy: check_retrieved_material(chunk), profile retrieved; exclude and audit BLOCK chunks only; no record_risk_event; all excluded -> EMPTY; connection B03+
